title: What did their last move do?

provenance.authoredBy: Mentor (drafted with AI assistance, positions engine-verified)

steps.title: Read their move
steps.body: After every move they make, ask what it attacks now and what it will attack next. Many losses start with ignoring a quiet move that created a threat.
White just played Qf3. Black to move. Look at the bishop on c4 and the queen on f3 both aiming at f7.

steps.why: Queen and bishop both attack f7, and the king has no escape square.

steps.q: What is the best habit here?
options: Check their last move before my own plan
steps.why: Their threat comes before your plan.

cards.prompt: What do you ask after their move?
solution: What does it attack now and next?
